subject: Rate anchors & host cost map — AvaHealth qualification
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@avahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up: rate anchors and next steps from today

Hi Emma — thanks again for your time this morning. I wanted to break out the two quick asks we discussed and confirm next steps so we can get a scoped pilot in front of procurement quickly.

Recap (short):
- Usage profile: 3M–6M tokens/month initially, growth to ~20M over 12 months if MVP converts.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 400ms on short chat flows; some batch embeddings for search updates once/day.
- Data: PHI-in-scope for a subset (requires private deployment / VPC).
- Budget target: you mentioned $/1M-token target in the low double-digits — want to confirm the precise band.

Immediate asks from us to you:
1) Can you confirm the target $/1M token anchor you want us to price to (range is fine)?
2) Who is the procurement contact and preferred PO/contract cadence (monthly vs quarterly vs annual)?

What we’ll deliver next (by EOD 7/20):
- A short one-pager showing three rate anchors ($/1M) tied to concrete performance and hosting options (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private)
- A brief comparative table vs typical host and managed providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, common open-hosts) showing unit economics at the volumes you provided
- Draft scope for a 6-week pilot with an estimated cost delta and procurement checklist

I’ve attached the usage worksheet you sketched in the call and a draft benchmark export — will iterate after you confirm the anchor band.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: AvaHealth_MVP_usage_estimate.xlsx]

From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@avahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Li <k.li@avahealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: rate anchors and next steps from today

Hi Priyom — great recap, thanks. Confirming the anchor band we discussed: we want to see pricing scenarios anchored at $9–$14 per 1M tokens (this is the ceiling/aspirational floor we’ve been given by finance for the pilot).

Some clarifications:
- The 3M–6M/month is realistic for MVP; if we go to production we expect spiky bursts and a predictable steady-state of 12–20M/month in Year 1.
- Procurement: Kevin (cc’d) is the lead — monthly billing is preferred for the pilot but we can discuss quarterly for a longer commit.
- Security: we’ll need SOC2 evidence and a short note on KMS/HSM options for the private route.

Please include an explicit line item for the cost difference between Hosted and Private (incl. infra surcharge) so I can show it to Finance.

Emma
Emma Chen
Head of Product, AvaHealth
[Attachment: none]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@avahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kevin Li <k.li@avahealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Rate anchors + host cost map (summary & numbers)

Emma / Kevin — thanks for confirming. Below is the compact benchmark table we discussed (high level, per 1M tokens). Numbers are illustrative for the pilot pricing conversation; I’ve also attached a PDF with the same table and an amortized scenario for the 6-week pilot.

High-level unit cost map (per 1M tokens):
- Redwood (hosted API, default quantization): $11.00 / 1M tokens — includes prefix caching and standard batching assumptions for chat flows.
- Redwood (private deployment, incl. infra surcharge & KMS): $13.75 / 1M tokens — higher due to private infra and compliance overheads.
- OpenAI (reference public rates / blended): $18.00 / 1M tokens — reflects current list/managed endpoint benchmarks we see in similar enterprise deals.
- Anthropic (reference): $16.50 / 1M tokens — public managed endpoints and early enterprise bands.
- Open-host provider X (typical cheapest open-host): $9.00 / 1M tokens — lower unit price but expect 10–25% higher latency variance and no SLA for multi-tenant endpoints.

Notes and assumptions:
- The Redwood hosted price assumes 95th < 400ms for short-chat paths under continuous batching; cache hit rate assumed at 12% for repeated prompts in the MVP.
- Private deployment estimate includes reserved GPU capacity amortized across expected throughput and a modest managed-support premium (audit logging, encryption at rest with KMS).
- Open-host numbers vary widely by region and sustained commit; we show the low-end as a counterfactual but call out operational and latency risk.
- All numbers exclude taxes and data egress. Final pricing will depend on commit levels and the selected model/quantization profile.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether the $9–$14 anchor band is the final range Finance will accept for pilot comparison? if so, we’ll craft 3 concrete commercial options:
A. Low-commit hosted pilot (month-to-month) — target $13 / 1M
B. Mid-commit (3–6 months reserved capacity) — target $11 / 1M
C. Private pilot (VPC + compliance pack) — target $13.75 / 1M (as above)

Proposed next steps:
- We’ll send a one-page commercial appendix + short SOW by EOD 7/21.
- Kevin: can you share procurement terms (standard PO lead time, required insurance levels) so we can align the SOW?
- Ben will follow up with a short SOC2/KMS evidence packet tomorrow.

[Attachment: Redwood_rate_anchor_1M_compare.pdf]

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@avahealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kevin Li <k.li@avahealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2/KMS packet + proposed SOW delivery timeline

Emma / Kevin — looping in the procurement checklist and SOC2 summary as requested. Attached: short evidence bundle (SOC2 summary, KMS integration note) plus the one-page commercial appendix Priyom referenced.

What’s included:
- SOC2 summary (controls scope, audit date): internal-access and infra controls included; full report available under NDA.
- KMS note: options for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and our HSM integration patterns for private deployments.
- Commercial appendix: three options (A/B/C) with per-1M anchors and pilot assumptions.

Delivery timeline: we’ll send the full SOW and the DocuSign-ready commercial agreement by end of day Wednesday 7/24. If procurement wants to move faster we can prioritize.

Let me know if there’s any missing piece — Kevin, happy to hop on a 20-min sync if that helps speed approvals.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf, KMS_integration_note.pdf, Redwood_rate_anchor_1M_compare.pdf]
